Quick notes from infra: we did not push any kernel/runtime changes this morning. Timeline from traces:
- 08:52–08:59: increased latency correlates with a steady increase in long-sequence requests from a small set of customers (top contributor: novapay-prod).
- KV cache hit rate for gen.chat dropped ~12% at 08:51 (eviction correlated with a memory pressure event on gsvc-prod-14).
- gsvc-prod-14 logged several GC stalls; we have a follow-up ticket to increase heap/buffer thresholds.

Immediate mitigation:
1) Kick a targeted fallback for novapay-prod to a lower-cost variant (gen-lite-1) for ~30m to reduce sequence length and headroom.
2) Increase KV cache capacity on the host pool (hotfix) — rolling patch in progress (ETA 20m).

I'll update once patch is live. If product wants a longer-term change, we should discuss quota-based sequence caps and adaptive caching per-tenant.

-Jonas
